headline: Hospitals, clinics want Nevada to bolster protections for discount drug program
summary: Hospitals and clinics in Nevada are seeking state legislation to protect their ability to offer discounted drugs through the 340B program due to restrictions imposed by drug manufacturers, which could impact revenue streams used for health services for underserved patients.

headline: NC Budget and Tax Center director Alexandra Sirota on the problematic new constitutional amendments
summary: "Republican state legislative leaders reached agreement on a new state budget while also advancing constitutional amendments that could significantly impact future budgets and services, including proposed income tax cap reduction and local property tax cap."

headline: Lawmakers stripped the Board of Equalization of power. Now they’re fighting to join it
summary: California Board of Equalization elections this year are more contentious than recent years due to higher-profile candidates seeking positions, including state lawmakers Shannon Grove and Mike Gipson.

headline: Even wealthy Oakland County can’t dodge Michigan’s economic woes
summary: Oakland County and Michigan face significant economic challenges, including job losses in professional services tied to the struggling auto industry, which may impact future state budget forecasts and planning.

headline: Voters Could Add Immigrant Protection Measures For HPD In November
summary: Hawaii police officials clarify that their department does not engage in immigration enforcement activities.

headline: Rogers hospital to be first to use Arkansas’ initiative for doulas in maternal healthcare
summary: Northwest Arkansas hospital to pilot state initiative integrating doulas into maternal healthcare, aiming to improve outcomes and reduce navigational complexities in the complex healthcare system.

headline: Another lawsuit filed over treatment of ICE detainee at Ohio jail
summary: Butler County Sheriff’s Office faces lawsuit alleging racial slur use and excessive force against an immigrant detainee from Ecuador.

headline: Eleventh hour budget deal includes $4M compensation for ‘Groveland Four’
summary: Florida legislators reached a budget agreement for FY 2026-27 totaling roughly $115 billion, including $500 million for Everglades restoration and $31 million for AIDS drug program preservation.
